name: resizable
description: Accessible resizable panel groups and layouts with keyboard support.
purpose: Lets people drag a divider to grow or shrink neighboring panes without leaving the page.
bestFor: sidebars next to a main pane
avoidFor: layouts that must stay a single width on every screen
